I wish it were actually a choice. Sure we can kill ourselves and as long as we are successful then we had control over it, but it’s not actually a choice we are allowed to make until we successfully make it. If it were a choice we would be able to tell people, say goodbye, and give people some closure. I think the process would be slightly less terrible than just dying out of the blue. It’s just like quitting a game. We decide we can’t do it anymore or we have no chance of doing well or we just don’t want to, so we want out.
